decision.explanation: The question asks for the main actor in the film 'Let George Do It'. Multiple distinct versions of the film exist across different years and media formats, each with its own main actor. Document D1S2 explicitly identifies George Formby as the star of the 1940 British film version. Document D3S1 identifies George Wallace as the star of the 1938 film version. Document D5S1 refers to Bob Bailey as the lead in the 1946–1954 radio series version. These are distinct works with distinct actors, so all three are valid answers depending on the specific version referenced. Charlie Chaplin is incorrectly cited as the main actor in the film and is marked as a wrong argument in the audit.
